description.zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC. The end time must be later than the start time.

description.zh:
是否展示集群节点的备份集详情：
* **false**（默认）：展示集群节点的备份集信息。
* **true**：不展示集群节点的备份集信息。
description.en:
Specifies whether to show backup set information for shards in the instance.

*   **true**: does not show backup set information for shards in the instance.
*   **false** (default): shows backup set information for shards in the instance.

Valid values:

*   True
*   False

The number of entries per page.

Valid values:

*   30
*   50
*   100
*   200
*   300
*   5
*   10
*   15
*   20

description.zh: 实例所属的地域ID，可调用[DescribeRegions](~~473763~~)接口获取。
description.en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~473763~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

title.zh: 查询集群实例的备份列表
title.en: Query the backup list of a cluster instance

descriptions.zh: 本接口仅适用于云原生版实例。
descriptions.en: This API is applicable only to cloud-native instances.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore describe-cluster-backup-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id r-t4nj72oug5r5646qog --cluster-backup-id cb-hyxdof5x9kqbtust --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --start-time 2024-06-28T08:26Z --end-time 2024-07-01T09:26Z --no-shard-backup True --region cn-hangzhou
